title: InfoSec Assurance Foundry — evaluation golden set
description: Known-good cases per report type (a–f, d2) and advisory system (g/h/i) used by operations/evaluation/run_evals.py. Inputs are synthetic or public only; real supplier material stays on the SharePoint site under Governance/ComparisonSet/ and is referenced by relative path + sha256, never copied into the repository. Controls: ISO 42001 A.6.2.4 / A.8.4, ISO 27001:2022 A.8.29, EU AI Act Art. 9(6)–(8).

inputs_root.description: Site path that case input paths are relative to (default Governance/ComparisonSet/inputs/)

baseline_root.description: Site path that baseline paths are relative to (default Governance/ComparisonSet/baseline/)

floors.description: Aggregate metric floors (fraction of evaluated cases, 0–1). Gate G1 fails when any metric is below its floor (EVALUATION.md §4). Per-case overrides live in case.floors.

kind.description: report = pipeline deliverable checked to the verifier; advisory = in-thread answer (g/h); routing = orchestrator hand-off / read-only behaviour (i); verifier-negative = a defective draft that MUST fail

pipeline.description: Key in workflows/pipelines.json (or the template workflow); omitted for advisory/routing cases

agent.description: Producing agent name as created by create_agents.py / create_delivery_agents.py / create_orchestrator.py

tier_of_record.description: model_tier in integrations/registry.json at the time the case was baselined

expected_verdict.description: Expected output-verifier verdict (FAIL only for verifier-negative cases)

fixture.description: Short SYNTHETIC sample output used by --dry-run to exercise the deterministic checks offline (never a real deliverable)

fixture_verdict.description: Verifier verdict to assume for the fixture in --dry-run

author.description: Placeholder UPN of the team member who authored the case

prompt.description: User message sent to the agent (pipeline cases: the same Supplier/Service framing the trigger would send)

path.description: Relative to inputs_root — synthetic/anonymised/public material only

output_format.description: What the agent's draft text is parsed as before checks (docx/pptx/xlsx pipelines evaluate the agent's verified JSON draft; the rendered binary is covered by baseline sha256)

required_sections.description: Case-insensitive substrings (or JSON keys when output_format=json) that must all be present — structure_fidelity

forbidden_patterns.description: Regexes; defaults to the verifier's placeholder rule ({{TOKEN}}, TBD, lorem, xxx) — placeholder_free

citation_pattern.description: Regex a valid citation matches (e.g. Art\.\s?\d+ or A\.\d+\.\d+) — grounding_rate / citation_validity

allowed_citation_sources.description: Every citation must name one of these frameworks/sources (substring match) — citation_validity

pattern.description: Regex with one numeric capture group, e.g. data-overall-score="(\d+)"

score_attribute.description: Score/threshold exactness against the known-good range — threshold_exactness

deterministic.description: true = the output must hash-match (rendered files, light-tier transformations); false = informational diff only

internal_markers.description: Strings that must never appear in the output (or, live, in any web-search query span) — egress_clean; defaults to the platform markers

expect_handoff_to.description: routing cases: agent the orchestrator must hand off to (checked as a substring of the answer/trace)

expect_no_write_language.description: The draft must be framed as awaiting approval, never as submitted (verifier rule 7)

budget.description: Per-case token/latency/cost ceilings from FINOPS.md §2 — budget_ok
